reason: Guest describes concrete long-only daily breakout rules on US stocks with momentum, consolidation, trailing stops and partial exits that can be approximated on daily bars.

universe.description: US stocks, strongest 2% by 1-18mo momentum, min $150M avg daily volume (was $20M earlier), mid/large caps preferred for liquidity

setup.rule: Stock has prior leg higher (several weeks/months), then sideways/pullback consolidation with contracting volatility/range
setup.quote: you have a leg higher and then it usually goes sideways or pull backs pulls back and uh many times what happens is the volatility contracts like it gets tighter

setup.rule: Relative strength: holds up best during market corrections, builds higher lows
setup.quote: the stocks that held up the most that had big moves previously and held up the most

entry.rule: Buy breakout of the consolidation range (daily obvious breakout); can use 1/5/60min opening range high for timing
entry.quote: our goal is to identify that those stair steps and buy it just as it is about to break out into the next

entry.rule: Buy aggressively at once on breakout
entry.quote: i buy everything at once uh very aggressively

stop.rule: Initial stop = low of the day (or low of the breakout candle on 1/5/60min)
stop.quote: then i use the low sorry day as my stop

stop.rule: Trail with 10 or 20-day MA after MA catches up; wait for close to exit on violation
stop.quote: once the moving averages the 10 and the 20 the moving averages it depends on the stock the faster moving stops are you stocks i moved uh i used the 10 day and the slow we're moving once i use the 20 day

exits.rule: Partial exit 20-25% into first momentum burst/strength to lock profits
exits.quote: i always sell some into that first burst uh to lock in a little bit of profits maybe i sell 20 or 25

exits.rule: Remainder trailed with 10/20 MA or sell after 3-5 days for shorter swings
exits.quote: you can you know hold them for maybe three to five days or and just settle into strength or you can try to hold for bigger moves uh like even try to hold through the next several steps uh and maybe use the moving averages like i do the 10 and 20 day moving averages trailing stops

sizing.rule: No fixed risk % or max positions stated; scales up with account, can reach 15-30 positions in strong markets
sizing.quote: i end up with a lot of positions because i take some partial profits and some and then i roll that money into new positions new breakouts and i can end up with you know 20 25 and i've had 30 positions sometimes

market_filter.rule: Only trade in uptrending or sideways markets; best after 5-15% market correction when leaders show relative strength; avoid bear markets
market_filter.quote: you obviously need uh uh up trending or sideways market to trade this method

ambiguities.issue: Exact momentum_lookback_days, momentum_min_pct, consolidation_days and consolidation_max_range_pct not numeric
ambiguities.assumption: Use 3mo/6mo/12mo lookbacks for momentum scan; consolidation 20-60 days with <10-15% range as typical from stair-step description

ambiguities.issue: No explicit risk_per_trade_pct or max_position_pct given
ambiguities.assumption: Omit or default to standard 1% risk / 10% max pos since not stated
